description: This file defines the PermissionCheckService class, which manages permission checks, resource permissions, and team membership permissions within a role-based access control system, specifically utilizing feature flags for PBAC (Policy-Based Access Control).

classes.name: PermissionCheckService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to check user permissions, resource permissions, and team permissions, integrating feature flags and role hierarchy logic.

methods.name: getUserPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves all team permissions for a given user.

methods.name: getResourcePermissions
methods.description: Fetches permissions for a specific resource within a team context, considering feature flag PBAC.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific permission within a team, considering fallback roles if PBAC is disabled.

methods.name: checkPermissions
methods.description: Checks if a user has all specified permissions within a team, considering fallback roles if PBAC is disabled.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Internal method to verify if a role has a specific permission.

methods.name: hasPermissions
methods.description: Internal method to verify if a role has multiple permissions.

methods.name: getMembership
methods.description: Retrieves membership and organizational membership details for a user in a team.

methods.name: checkFallbackRoles
methods.description: Checks if a user's role is within the allowed fallback roles.

methods.name: getHighestRole
methods.description: Determines the highest role between two roles based on hierarchy.

methods.name: getTeamIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves team IDs where a user has a specific permission, optionally scoped to an organization.

methods.name: getTeamIdsWithPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves team IDs where a user has all of a set of permissions, optionally scoped to an organization.
